# Risk and Quality Gates

The Awtsmoos gives expansion gevurah: every added ray needs a boundary so Awtsmoos.com remains fast, private, and true.

## Critical risks

- Accidentally indexing auth, admin, API, edit, submit, delete, staging, debug, or private pages.
- Duplicating app/game content under generated alternate URLs.
- Injecting metadata into JSON/assets or HTML fragments instead of full documents.
- Creating canonical URLs that disagree with registry hrefs.
- Using imported attribution aliases as real public profiles.
- Loading entire comment/post bodies merely to build sitemaps.
- Translation title lookups depending on production-only state, making builds nondeterministic.
- Breaking CSP, script order, or game/app loading through response mutation.
- Growing generated artifacts beyond the 120-line project ceiling.

## Required gates

- Fresh origin/main race check before writes and before push.
- Whole-file writes only.
- New/touched code <=120 lines per file.
- Syntax/import checks.
- Existing Heichel quality + route tests.
- Focused SEO tests for registries, response enrichment, aliases, translations, comments.
- Real-data local runtime acceptance.
- Raw public HTTP acceptance after guarded release.
